title: Client Coordinator
description:
Client Coordinator

Shrewsbury

Temporary - Permanent

Monday-Friday, 8:30am 5:00pm

Salary £28000 - £33000

Annual leave 25 days + Bank Holidays when the role goes permanent

We are looking for an organised, proactive and customer-focused Client Coordinator to support the delivery of smaller projects across a varied client portfolio. Working alongside Technical Project Managers you will coordinate the administrative and operational activity required to keep projects moving from initial instruction through to completion.

This is a busy, varied role requiring someone who can manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate records and communicate confidently with customers, engineers, subcontractors and internal teams.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Workflow Coordination
- Coordinate multiple projects, ensuring actions, deadlines and requirements are followed through.
- Support Technical Project Managers with scheduling, mobilisation and ongoing project administration.
- Coordinate engineer and subcontractor attendance, materials and other project requirements.
- Raise and track subcontractor work orders and monitor progress through to completion.
- Maintain accurate project trackers and proactively highlight delays, risks or issues.
- Support quotations, purchase orders, variations, uplifts and invoicing.

Systems & Administration
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date project information within the CRM system.
- Update job statuses, costs, documentation, subcontractor information and project progress.
- Ensure project documentation is complete, accurate and consistently maintained.
- Assist with reporting, KPI tracking and general system administration.

Customer & Stakeholder Management
- Act as a key point of contact for customers, subcontractors and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle.
- Respond to queries professionally and provide clear, proactive updates.
- Build strong working relationships with customers and operational teams.
- Support Project Managers and Senior Management with regular project updates.

Compliance & Commercial Support
- Ensure projects follow internal processes and required governance procedures.
- Support the collation of project handover documentation.
- Assist with tracking project costs, variations and operational updates.
- Help ensure projects are delivered on time, within agreed requirements and in line with company procedures.
- Identify opportunities to improve processes and operational efficiency.

About You

We are looking for someone who is highly organised, commercially aware and comfortable working in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.

You will ideally have:
- Experience in project coordination, administration or a similar operational role.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple live projects and competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and confidence working with systems, documentation and data.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach and the confidence to identify and escalate issues when required.
- Good IT skills and experience using business management or project systems.

The application process:

Our mission is to support our clients in their creation of an equal, diverse and inclusive workforce. We are committed to providing a barrier-free recruitment process, so if you require any reasonable accessibility adjustments within the application process, then please make it known at the earliest opportunity.

We will carefully consider your details and advise you if we're able to progress with your application within 72 working hours. If you do not hear from us within this time your details won t be retained. So, if you're not successful on this occasion, do continue to respond to future roles we advertise. In the meantime, all good wishes and continued success with your search for employment.

About Us

Prince Personnel are an employment agency working on behalf of our client. Whether you re seeking a new permanent position, temporary assignment or contract you ll find us easy to deal with. Located in thriving Telford, we focus on jobs in Shropshire, Staffordshire and North Wales. Prince Personnel specialise in commercial, accounts and finance and technical recruitment. With the best jobs around we are an independent agency working hard for you.

description:
Business Support Officer

Hourly Rate: 14.59 per hour
Location: Darby House, Telford, TF3 4 JA / Hybrid Working Available
Hours: 37 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Contract: Temporary basis, up to 6 months

About the Role

Opus People Solutions are recruiting on behalf of Telford and Wrekin Council for a Business Support Officer to join the Children's Social Care Service. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator to provide high-quality business support within a fast-paced and rewarding environment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the service through effective administration, coordination, and communication. You will be highly organised, possess excellent attention to detail, and be confident managing a varied workload while supporting professionals across the service.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain accurate records, databases, and filing systems in accordance with organisational procedures.
- Manage shared inboxes and diaries, prioritising appointments and responding to enquiries efficiently.
- Organise meetings, conferences, and room bookings, ensuring all necessary arrangements and documentation are in place.
- Attend meetings in person and accurately record, produce, and distribute detailed minutes within agreed timescales.
- Prepare and process routine correspondence, reports, documents, and presentations to support operational teams.
- Update and maintain information across a range of systems to ensure data accuracy and compliance.
- Provide professional administrative support to managers and staff within Children's Social Care.
- Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- Liaise effectively with internal departments, external agencies, and service users.

Essential Experience and Skills

To be successful in this role, you must have:
- Strong previous experience in an administrative or business support role.
- Proven experience of taking accurate and detailed typed minutes during meetings in person.
- Experience using Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and PowerPoint.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate work.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage professionally with a wide range of stakeholders.
- Experience managing diaries, inboxes, meetings, and complex administrative processes.
- The ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.
- Experience maintaining confidential information and handling sensitive data appropriately.

Desirable Experience
- Previous experience working within a local authority, public sector organisation, or Children's Social Care environment.
- Familiarity with case management or document management systems.

All offers will be subject to satisfactory compliance screening, including right to work in the UK and references

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
About the Company

Vivactive is an award-winning business that stands among the fastest growing in the West Midlands. The company s long-term aim is to become the biggest incontinence provider in Europe; here, you will have an opportunity to be part of it. Recognised as an award-winning company with outstanding people and an entrepreneurial environment, the ideal candidate will enjoy the buzz of being part of a market-leading business with exceptional people.

About the Role

As our Customer Service Advisor, you will provide knowledgeable and sensitive support to customers across phone, email and live chat. You will help customers choose suitable incontinence products, place and manage orders, resolve queries and complete associated administration. You will often support elderly or vulnerable customers and discuss personal topics, so empathy, discretion and confidence are essential.

Key Responsibilities

What you ll be doing:
- Provide warm, professional customer service, primarily by telephone, supporting customers from product advice and delivery queries through to placing orders.
- Support elderly and vulnerable customers with patience, empathy and clear communication, adapting your approach to individual needs.
- Handle sensitive conversations about incontinence, bodily functions and anatomy confidently, respectfully and without judgement.
- Manage customer queries and casework across email and live chat, including back orders, returns, refunds and delivery-related issues.
- Accurately process orders, payments and customer information while working fully in line with PCI DSS, GDPR and internal procedures.

What we re looking for:
- A naturally warm, friendly and empathetic approach to customer service.
- Confident speaking with customers on the telephone for much of the working day.
- Comfortable discussing sensitive and personal subjects in a professional, respectful manner.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly.
- Good IT literacy and confidence in learning and working across multiple systems.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to accurately record customer information and process orders.
- A calm, patient approach when supporting elderly, vulnerable or distressed customers.
- Good organisation and the ability to balance calls with email, live chat and administrative casework.
- A positive, collaborative attitude and willingness to contribute to a warm and friendly team environment.

Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Essential

These are the minimum requirements needed to perform the role successfully.

Knowledge
- Understanding of what good customer service looks like, including empathy, active listening and clear communication.

= Awareness of the importance of confidentiality and handling personal information appropriately.
- Understanding of the need for accuracy when processing customer details, orders and payments.

Desirable
- These requirements would be advantageous but are not essential.

Knowledge
- Knowledge of GDPR and the principles of handling personal data securely.
- Knowledge of incontinence products or experience working in a health, care or medical-adjacent environment.
- Awareness of PCI DSS requirements when taking or processing card payments.

Skills
- Ability to communicate confidently with elderly or vulnerable customers.
- Ability to handle sensitive conversations with tact and discretion.
- Confidence switching between telephone, email, live chat and administrative tasks.

Experience
- Previous telephone-based customer service or contact centre experience.
- Experience processing orders, refunds, returns or delivery queries.
- Experience supporting vulnerable customers or working with sensitive personal information.

Core Behaviours

All employees are expected to demonstrate the following behaviours:
- Customer Focus
- Puts customers at the heart of decision-making and service delivery.
- Accountability
- Takes ownership of responsibilities and delivers on commitments.
- Collaboration
- Works effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.
- Continuous Improvement
- Seeks opportunities to improve processes, services and performance.
- Respect & Inclusion
- Treats others fairly, professionally and with respect.

Working Conditions:
- The role is desk-based and involves extended periods using a computer and telephone headset
- Based in a busy, lively office environment with a high volume of telephone activity and regular interaction with colleagues.
- The office can be noisy at times, so you ll need to be comfortable working in a fast-paced, energetic environment while maintaining focus and professionalism .
- Working as part of a warm, friendly and collaborative Customer Service team.

Interview Process:

One-stage, in-person interview including a 1-hour working interview. This gives you the opportunity to see the role and systems in practice, while allowing us to assess your communication, IT literacy, accuracy and overall competence for the role.

Benefits

What s in it for you? Please take the time to read our extensive list of benefits below:
- A chance to build and grow a department in a rapidly expanding/award-winning company
- Market-leading annual leave starting at 23 days plus 8 bank holidays (31 days in total), which grows with the length of service
- Your birthday off
- We ll pay for your external training courses
- Awards and Recognition Schemes; delivering above and beyond never goes unnoticed
- Free Onsite Parking
- Complimentary tea, coffee, chilled water and soft drinks
- Pension Scheme
- Free Summer BBQ
- We care about our employee s mental and physical health with well-being practices embedded in the company
- An environmentally conscious company
- Apprenticeship Scheme
- Free Eye Tests
- Cycle 2 Work Scheme
- Monthly Social Events (Bowling, Escape Room, Bake Off, Pumpkin Carving, Wellbeing Walks etc.)
- Length of Service bonus (5/10/15 year)

Work in a fun and lively environment in an up-and-coming business! You will be a crucial member of the Vivactive team. This is an incredible opportunity for an outstanding person; if you believe this is YOU, don t hesitate to apply now.

Vivactive is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with dignity and respect. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to providing equal access to employment, development, and progression opportunities. Our recruitment and employment practices are based on merit, skills, and experience.

title: Recruitment Account Coordinator
description:
Full time (40h) - In Branch - Temp ongoing - 5 out of 7 days

Salary: £14.42 per hour

Have you considered a career in recruitment? You possess drive, ambition, discipline, and structure, but haven't yet had the opportunity to put it all into practice? Come and showcase your potential at Staffline.

The Opportunity

This is your chance to join the UK's largest recruitment business as a Temporary Onsite Recruitment Account Coordinator. In this role, you'll be providing temporary workers to our highly successful warehousing operation in Telford.

To excel in this role, your focus will be on customers, committed to delivering the best service, and a natural problem solver. While experience in on-site recruitment would be beneficial, it's not an essential requirement. If you have transferable skills, we can provide training on all the elements essential for success in this position.

What you'll do as a Onsite Recruitment Account Coordinator

This role thrives on pace - helping candidates find the best jobs, solving problems, and enhancing the candidate experience and work environment. It's a wonderfully diverse role that will undoubtedly keep you engaged. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:
- Meeting client deadlines by fulfilling staffing requirements
- Recruitment, selection, and onboarding of workers
- Accurate data input and validation for weekly payroll
- Handling administrative processes such as absences and change requests
- Ensuring compliance and maintaining secure records for audits
- Providing a positive customer experience and efficiently addressing worker queries

The skills you'll develop as a Onsite Recruitment Account Coordinator

Throughout your time at Staffline, you'll receive coaching and challenges that will facilitate skill growth. In this role, you can anticipate enhancing skills related to client and relationship management, hiring and staffing processes, and identifying opportunities for performance improvement - among a range of other areas. At Staffline, we actively encourage progression and personal development, with dedicated progression paths for those who join us.

What we need from you

By now, it should be evident that we're dedicated to your development, fair rewards, and encouraging you to excel in your role at Staffline. To succeed in this position, a few things are required:
- Swift adaptation to changing priorities and effective problem-solving skills
- A customer-centric mindset, prioritizing people above all else
- Ideally, experience within the recruitment industry (though not essential)
- A growth mindset, consistently seeking innovative approaches while fulfilling both client and customer needs
- Strong relationship-building abilities, confidently establishing and maintaining connections with clients and customers
- Most importantly, tenacity, drive, flexibility, and a positive attitude toward delivering excellent service.

Diversity and Inclusion: A Core Focus

At Staffline, we are deeply committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe that a diverse team brings different perspectives, ideas, and experiences, enhancing our overall effectiveness and success. We value and celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, and we actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Intrigued? Why not apply now? Or if you need more information, get in touch.

Note: All candidates must demonstrate their Right to Work in the UK. A full UK driver's license is highly desired for this role.
